terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
1. This service provides Minecraft skin hosting and mod distribution, offered as-is with no availability guarantee.
2. You are responsible for all activity under your account; keep credentials safe and report misuse promptly.
3. Uploading illegal, infringing, malicious (virus/backdoor) content or abusing the service (scraping, load testing) is prohibited.
4. Operators may remove violating content, ban violating accounts, and retain audit logs for traceability.
5. The service may change, be interrupted, or terminated; material changes are announced on-site.
6. Continued use constitutes acceptance; updated terms supersede prior versions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
1. What we collect: email, nickname, player names, uploaded skins/capes/mod files, comments and likes, and security logs (IP, audit records).
2. Purpose: authentication, content delivery, abuse prevention and moderation, legal compliance. We do not sell data or use it for unrelated marketing.
3. Cookies & sessions: login state lives in httpOnly cookies; theme and language preferences live in local storage.
4. Third parties: only when you use the relevant feature do we exchange necessary data with Microsoft (premium binding), captcha providers, and email providers.
5. Retention: account and content are removed upon deletion; security logs are kept for a limited compliance period.
6. Your rights: access, rectify, and delete your data via the published contact channel.
7. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

dmca.title: Copyright (DMCA)
dmca.body:
1. If you believe content here infringes your copyright, submit a takedown notice including: the work, infringing URLs, contact info, a good-faith statement, and an accuracy statement.
2. Upon verification, operators remove the content and may sanction the uploader; the affected party may file a counter-notice.
3. Repeat infringers are terminated.
4. Use the published contact channel; false or bad-faith notices carry liability.

home.desc: Upload skins and capes, plug into the Yggdrasil API, and clients load them automatically. Premium players keep their real identity.
home.step1Body: Upload a PNG from your profile, optionally publish it to the library, with instant 3D preview.
home.step2Body: Point authlib-injector at this site's Yggdrasil endpoint.
home.step3Body: Players join and see their own skin and cape — no mods or resource packs.
home.featLibBody: Publish, like, comment, and apply any skin to your player in one click; review and reports keep the library clean.
home.featPremiumBody: Bind a Microsoft account to keep your real UUID, with skins falling back to Mojang.
home.featModsBody: Modrinth-compatible uploads, versions and dependency distribution, with one-click .mrpack export.
